pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with stellate or crenelated edges. Darker brown patches show dendritic protrusions into the surrounding light regions, creating a non-smooth edge gradient.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored negative space. Junctions are predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial nodes. Pathways maintain a relatively consistent pixel thickness throughout the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette along the upper neck mane. Individual hair bundles create a jagged, fine-textured 1D contour against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small avian organism (Oxpecker) is perched on the posterior dorsal ridge near the shoulder-rump transition, creating a localized disruption in the dorsal silhouette.
